harvest_cal.description: Honduras has a single annual harvest (cosecha), unlike Colombia's bimodal pattern. Flowering occurs Apr–Jun, fruit develops Jul–Sep, and harvest runs Oct–Feb (peak Nov–Jan). Honduras is the largest arabica producer in Central America.
